summary: S-3 (Note count on the page) meets C-7. public/index.html fetches /api/notes and writes notes.length + " notes" into #count; src/server.mjs serves /api/notes from listNotes(store). A live run of the server returned the page with the count script and /api/notes returned []. The page therefore shows "0 notes", which equals the store size. npm test passes 5/5. No block findings. One major behavior risk: nothing in the server writes to the store, so the displayed count can only ever be 0 in the running server.

findings.issue: The server's store is a module-level `const store = []` and no route or code path pushes notes into it. The count the page shows is therefore always 0 in the running server, so C-7 holds only trivially. The page would show a wrong count once notes can be created in the server process. This is a behavior risk for the slice's observable feature, not a criterion failure, because C-7 defines N as the size of the store and the store is empty.
findings.suggestion: Before relying on the count in a real flow, wire a write path into the store or have the spec owner confirm that an empty server store is the intended scope for this version.

evidence.quote: PORT=4987 node src/server.mjs; curl http://localhost:4987/api/notes returned []

findings.issue: No automated test covers the C-7 behavior. The page script and the /api/notes route are only checked by hand. The npm test suite covers only src/notes.mjs and src/export.mjs.
findings.suggestion: Optionally add a test that starts the server on a free port and asserts that /api/notes returns a JSON array and that / contains the count script.

findings.issue: The page prints "1 notes" for a single note, because the text is built without pluralization. The spec literally says "N notes", so this is consistent with the criterion as written.
findings.suggestion: Leave as is unless the owner wants singular handling.

criteria.note: Spec: openspec/changes/lantern-v0-2/specs/notes/spec.md, requirement 'Note count on the page' (scenario 'Count shown'), and handoff/HANDOFF.md I-5 C-7. The page at / shows "N notes" with N = size of the server store (0). The count is computed from the store through listNotes, so it reflects the store, though the store is always empty in this version (see F-1).

browser.note: No browser run. The page script was checked by reading it and by fetching the page and API from a live server process.
